purpose: Public-metadata identity and radio-policy fixtures, not a listening-quality evaluation.
limitations: Official artist or label uploads and primary catalog pages establish identity and provenance. They do not establish current regional availability, embedding permission, audio quality, or recommendation taste.
Catalog album categories retain their original scope. Do not turn Pop, Dance, or R&B/Soul into a verified track subgenre or unrelated-artist recommendation proof.
YouTube upload dates, original releases, remasters, and re-recordings are distinct. Rehydrate the selected video duration and live status before applying the 90 to 600 second automatic-radio policy.
Expected policy cases describe assertions to test, not results of a live probe. Broad-genre seeds may legitimately have no admissible cross-artist candidate.
No media, lyrics, account data, credentials, cookies, or production data are included.
